en: The image shows a colorized view of a picturesque street lined with ornate, historic brick buildings in the Flemish Renaissance style, featuring stepped gables and decorative facades. The street is quiet and cobblestoned, with a few windows open and a streetlamp visible. The caption at the bottom reads 'BRUGES. – La Maison des Métiers.' A handwritten date, '22/8/07,' is visible at the top.
